$comment: Where each build of the extension finds its backend (docs/RELEASING.md). Read by scripts/build.js; everything here ends up in the extension, so only public values belong here (the Google client ID is public). apiUrl is scheme + host (+ port): REST uses it and the WebSocket is derived from it (https -> wss). Fill staging/production apiUrl and googleClientId before building them.

pre.$comment: PRE: the backend on Railway, for the unpacked extension (npm run build:pre, then reload compiled/ in chrome://extensions). Keeps the manifest key, so it has the same extension ID as development: the same CORS origin and Google redirect URI.

store-draft.$comment: Only to create the Chrome Web Store item and get its extension ID before a public backend exists (docs/RELEASING.md section 5). Upload it as a draft and never submit it for review: it points at a local backend.
